title: The 1929 Dallas State Fair and the band's beginning
summary: Albert's band began at the Dallas fair in October 1929, driven from New Orleans on Goldberg's money, and added Hiram Harding on arrival.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: We were talking about the Dallas State Fair, how your band got started there. What went on at the Dallas State Fair? See, I never was at a...

Well, that's every October. That's a regular, one of the regular celebrations that they have. The world's fast stage fair. And this year, I don't remember what year it was that I was playing with. But it was in October of 1929. And the band that organized in New Orleans out there, Bernard Goldberg, had given me that money. We drove all the way from New Orleans, all the way from New Orleans into Dallas. And that was... Well, maybe I'll say that the Lord's blessed me more ways when one, it was... This was the only engagement that Bernard Goldberg had that was paying me enough money. And he could finance my band. And he could finance the uniforms. But he stayed with the band, booking it. But what happened, a few nights before we closed the State Fair, we didn't know what we were doing. I don't know how this man ever got the phone. I don't know where I was. He was here in San Antonio with Lala Estes. And he called me and asked me, could I come to San Antonio on a job? And it was a job that Troy Floyd was on, the Chicken Plantation. Troy had had a phone out with him and he was giving me his notice. He was going to Oklahoma, which was a blessing for me. So I took the job. And that's how we came on in the San Antonio. We were able to increase the band. We were able to rehearse the band and get it in the shape that he was in. And from that he got into Shatner.
So you added men once the State Fair was over?
I added the first, as soon as I got to Dallas I met Hiram Harding, who had just come into Dallas. And I supplemented him with me, two drumsticks there in the truck. That's how I became the 10 Pounds.
